pull_request.body:
## Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  This PR addresses three issues:                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  ### Closes #319 — Add .editorconfig                                                                                                                                                                          
  - Adds a `.editorconfig` at the repository root to enforce consistent whitespace, indentation, and line endings across editors.                                                                              
  - Configures rules for `*.rs`, `*.toml`, `*.md`, `*.yml`, and `Makefile` files.                                                                                                                              
  - No existing files modified — config-only change.                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  ### Closes #321 — Add CHANGELOG.md link to README                                                                                                                                                            
  - `CHANGELOG.md` already existed and follows Keep a Changelog format with `[Unreleased]`, `[0.1.1]`, and `[0.1.0]` sections.                                                                                 
  - Adds a one-line link from `README.md` (Contributing section) to `CHANGELOG.md` so users can discover the release history.                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  ### Closes #322 — Replace .unwrap() calls                                                                                                                                                                    
  - `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` was inspected and contains **zero bare `.unwrap()` calls** — only safe `unwrap_or_default()` calls are present.                                                            
  - No changes needed; the file is already compliant.
